##Описательная статистика для ЭКГ

```{r data loading}

df <- read.csv("C:/Users/User/Desktop/Biostat_HW/Hackathon_industrial_biostatistics/data/raw/team6_ecrf_wide.csv")

```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

n_patients <- df %>% nrow()

classified_by_arm <- df %>%
  select(USUBJID, ARM, V1_ECG_RHYTHM_ABN, V1_ECG_STT_ABN, V1_ECG_QT_ABN) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("V1_ECG"),
    names_to = "PARAM",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(PARAM, ARM) %>%
  summarise(overall = n(), .groups = "drop")

tab_by_arm <- df %>%
  select(USUBJID, ARM, V1_ECG_RHYTHM_ABN, V1_ECG_STT_ABN, V1_ECG_QT_ABN) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("V1_ECG"),
    names_to = "PARAM",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(PARAM, ARM, value) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(classified_by_arm, by = c("PARAM", "ARM")) %>%
  mutate(n_perc = sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", n, 100 * n / overall))

tab_all <- df %>%
  select(USUBJID, ARM, V1_ECG_RHYTHM_ABN, V1_ECG_STT_ABN, V1_ECG_QT_ABN) %>%
  mutate(ARM = "Все пациенты") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("V1_ECG"),
    names_to = "PARAM",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(PARAM, ARM, value) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(n_perc = sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", n, 100 * n / n_patients))

tab_full <- bind_rows(tab_by_arm, tab_all) %>%
  mutate(
    value = recode(as.character(value),
                   "0" = "Норма",
                   "1" = "Отклонение от нормы"),
    ARM = recode(as.character(ARM),
                 "Traumeel" = "Траумель",
                 "Diclofenac" = "Диклофенак")
  )


tab_wide <- tab_full %>%
  select(PARAM, value, ARM, n_perc) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = ARM,
    values_from = n_perc
  ) %>%
  arrange(PARAM, factor(value, levels = c("Норма", "Отклонение от нормы"))) %>%
  mutate(PARAM = case_when(
    str_detect(PARAM, "QT_ABN") ~ "QT-аномалия",
    str_detect(PARAM, "RHYTHM_ABN") ~ "Нарушение ритма",
    str_detect(PARAM, "STT_ABN") ~ "Изменения ST-T",
    TRUE ~ PARAM
  ))

```

```{r}

flextable(tab_wide) %>%

  set_header_labels(
    PARAM = "Параметр",
    value = "Категория"
  ) %>%
  
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(part = "header", align = "center") %>%
  align(j = c("PARAM"), part = "body", align = "left") %>%
  align(j = "value", part = "body", align = "left") %>%
  align(j = setdiff(names(tab_wide), c("PARAM","value")),
        part = "body", align = "center") %>%
  valign(part = "all", valign = "center") %>%
  merge_v(j = c("PARAM")) %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  autofit()

```
